judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports hit every expectation with equivalent evidence and depth; they are comparable.

report_1.evidence: **"Two-factor authentication is now enabled for every clinic by default" — false.** `clinic-portal/app/security/config.py:4` sets `TWO_FACTOR_DEFAULT = False` ... **"Patients can now export their full visit history as a PDF" — false.** `clinic-portal/app/routers/visits.py` contains only a `list_visits` endpoint that returns an empty list, and line 11 is literally `# TODO: pdf export`. The feature does not exist. The section (and its image reference, see below) must be removed.

report_2.evidence: **"Patients can now export their full visit history as a PDF" (line 24) — false; remove the section.** `app/routers/visits.py` contains only `GET /visits`, which returns an empty list, and the file ends with the comment `# TODO: pdf export` ... **"Two-factor authentication is now enabled for every clinic by default" (line 30) — false; correct or remove.** `app/security/config.py` sets `TWO_FACTOR_DEFAULT = False`

report_1.evidence: `img/after_scheduling.png` shows a "BILLING / INVOICES" screen, while `img/before_scheduling.png` shows "SCHEDULING CALENDAR". The manifest confirms this is a capture mix-up ... `after_scheduling.png` from route `/billing/invoices`

report_2.evidence: `before_scheduling.png` is the scheduling calendar ("SCHEDULING CALENDAR") while `after_scheduling.png` is the billing screen ("BILLING / INVOICES"). The capture manifest confirms this ... `after_scheduling.png` from route `/billing/invoices`

report_1.evidence: `img/after_export.png` | **does not exist** | Broken reference — no such file anywhere in the workspace ... `img/unused_capture_07.png` | **Orphan** — exists on disk and in git but is referenced neither by the doc nor by `captures.json`

report_2.evidence: `img/after_export.png` is referenced by the Export section but does not exist anywhere ... Second, `img/unused_capture_07.png` exists on disk (and is committed) but is referenced by nothing and has no manifest entry

report_1.evidence: **The footer "Highlights draft assembled with AI assistance." (line 33).** It is an internal drafting note ... remove the line

report_2.evidence: **The footer, line 33: "Highlights draft assembled with AI assistance."** ... a "draft … AI assistance" line in a polished customer email is clearly an internal artifact, and I would remove it
